conventions.convention: Geometric braids have one point on each horizontal level; endpoints match the base configuration as a set, and the endpoint permutation records the top labeling. Braid isotopy keeps the bottom points and top set fixed and every intermediate slice a braid.
The positive elementary half twist is anticlockwise, supported in the specified disc; stacking is written γ⋆β, with group product [γ][β].
Left divisibility of positive braids means b = a c; left normal forms greedily use the greatest common left divisor with Δ.
Fundamental-group multiplication [α][β]=[α*β] traverses α first, then β. Endpoint monodromy is the unique permutation σ for which the lifted loop ends at σ·q.
Quiver paths compose left to right. P_i=A_m e_i is spanned by paths ending at i, while e_i A_m is spanned by paths beginning at i.
The internal shift is (M{r})_d=M_{d-r}; the homological shift is [1]. Totalization uses d(r⊗x)=d_R r⊗x+(-1)^p r⊗d_X x for r in homological degree p.

In the Soergel items, source shifts satisfy M(k)=M{-k}; coordinate roots β_i=x_i−x_{i+1} govern Coxeter length, while balanced roots are α_i=(−1)^(i−1)β_i. The Hecke normalization uses q=v^−2 and H_i=v(T_i+1).

load_bearing.statement: For every n and base configuration Q, the isotopy classes of geometric braids form a group under the stated stacking product, and the endpoint permutation map to S_n is a well-defined homomorphism.
For every n, the assignment from Artin generators to the geometric half twists extends uniquely to a surjective homomorphism B_n→G_n. Only surjectivity is asserted.
For every n≥0, 1→PB_n→B_n^conf→S_n→1 is short exact, with the middle map the endpoint monodromy.

For a nonempty connected Hausdorff d-manifold without boundary, d≥2, and m,n≥1, forgetting the last n points has local fibre F_n(M\Q_q); the fibre types are homeomorphic across the base. Under AC it is a fixed-fibre bundle, and for M=int D² under AC and DC it is numerable and a Hurewicz fibration.
For m≥1, A_m has a Z-basis of 4m+1 paths: the vertices, arrows and degree-one returns described in the item.
For every object M of A_m-mod there is a finite graded projective resolution of length at most 2m+1.
For 1≤i≤m, U_i⊗U_i≅U_i⊕U_i{1}; for valid adjacent indices, U_i⊗U_{i±1}⊗U_i≅U_i{1}; and if |i−j|>1 then U_i⊗U_j=0.
If each term of a bounded bimodule complex is finitely generated graded projective on both sides, signed totalization gives an exact functor on C_m and agrees with derived tensor.
For each n≥2, every x∈B_n has a unique expression Δ^p a_1…a_r with p∈Z, r∈N, every a_i a proper simple braid, and a_i=Δ∧_L(a_i…a_r).
For n≥2, positive-word congruence, left divisibility and left gcds with Δ are decidable, and there is an explicit algorithm computing the left normal form of any braid word.
For objects M,N of SBim_n, Hom_R-R(M,N) is a graded free R-module of graded rank Σ_{x,d,e}(M:Δ_x(d))(N:∇_x(e))v^(d−e).
For words x̲,y̲, the double leaves form a homogeneous free left R-basis of Hom_D(x̲,y̲); with y̲ empty, the identity-indexed light leaves form a basis of Hom_D(x̲,empty).
For n≥2, the Karoubi-completed evaluation functor from the type-A diagrammatic category to SBim_n is full, faithful, essentially surjective, and a graded monoidal equivalence.
For n≥2, K_0^split(SBim_n) is isomorphic as a Z[v,v^−1]-algebra to H_Sn, sending [B_i] to H_i=v(T_i+1).

concerns.concern: Steps 4.1 and 5.1 invoke pasting on the open set S_j and the closed set M outside the closure of S_j. Those sets omit the boundary of S_j, so they do not form a cover there. The two formulas agree at the boundary and the bump construction makes continuity easy to recover, but the stated pasting argument does not itself establish continuity of h_{j,x} or the joint family at that boundary.

Step 2.3 says that when the product path w has length 2, the relation generator s_0 is a return. This omits the monotone length-two generators u_j u_{j+1} and d_{j+1} d_j, which are not returns. Their images under rho are zero by step 1.2, so the basis claim is unaffected, but this case must be handled separately for the proof that rho vanishes on I_m.

The reflection-faithfulness check identifies transpositions with distinct codimension-one fixed hyperplanes, but does not show that every element of S_n with a codimension-one fixed space is a transposition, as required to establish the stated reflection-faithful property. In this permutation representation the missing converse follows immediately from codim Fix(w)=n−number of cycles(w).

Step 2.1 justifies homogeneity using A_l P_i ⊆ P_{i+l} in internal degrees, which mixes the degree index with the vertex-projective index and is ill-typed as written. The graded-module axiom needed here is (A_m)_l(P_i)_d ⊆ (P_i)_{l+d}.

Step 3.2 computes the target differential after applying ξ without including the negative sign in the differential of the shifted total complex, then refers to that sign afterward. The chain-map identity holds when the target differential is written as −d; the displayed computation needs that correction to justify it.

seams_checked.note: The quiver bimodule-functor item states the cited tensor theorem with its separate hypotheses: underlying right A-flatness gives exactness, and finite graded left B-projectivity preserves finite graded projectives. The uses keep those assumptions distinct.
The Soergel items use the graded-bimodule definition’s internal shift M{r}_d=M_{d−r} and explicitly translate the source twist as M(k)=M{−k}; this preserves the cited shift convention.
